# Squeeze Complete System Documentation (llms-full.txt)

> Squeeze is a free, private, client-side image conversion and compression engine. 
> Canonical URL: https://www.trysqueeze.online
> Architecture: 100% In-Browser Execution via HTML5 Canvas, OffscreenCanvas, and Web Workers.

---

## 1. System Overview & Privacy Architecture

Traditional web image converters upload user images to remote cloud servers (AWS EC2, Google Cloud Storage, or third-party transcoding microservices). This poses significant privacy and compliance concerns regarding confidential photos, financial records, medical documents, and NDAs.

Squeeze changes this paradigm through a Zero-Upload, Client-Side execution model:
1. Files dropped onto the interface are read into memory via the browser's `FileReader` and `createImageBitmap` APIs.
2. Binary ArrayBuffers are transferred off the main UI thread to a pool of background Web Workers (`/workers/conversion.worker.js`).
3. Inside each worker, images are resampled, converted, or compressed using `OffscreenCanvas`.
4. Output blobs are wrapped in local memory Object URLs (`blob:https://...`) for instant download or packaged into `.zip` archives via client-side `JSZip`.
5. Zero image bytes leave the local computer. No server storage, no database records, and no API latency.

---

## 2. Supported Formats & Mechanics

### PNG (Portable Network Graphics)
- MIME: `image/png`
- Compression: Lossless Deflate (LZ77 + Huffman coding)
- Alpha Channel: Full 8-bit alpha channel (256 levels of transparency)
- Best For: Logos, UI icons, sharp graphics, screenshots with text.
- Conversion Notes: When converting from lossy formats (JPEG/WebP) to PNG, file size often increases because PNG uses strict lossless encoding.

### JPEG / JPG (Joint Photographic Experts Group)
- MIME: `image/jpeg`
- Compression: Lossy Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) + Chroma Subsampling (4:2:0)
- Alpha Channel: Unsupported.
- Transparency Behavior: When converting transparent PNG or WebP images to JPG, Squeeze automatically fills transparent pixels with a user-configurable matte color (default: `#FFFFFF` pure white) to prevent black-background artifacts.
- Best For: Photographs, complex gradients, photorealistic art.

### WebP (Google Modern Web Format)
- MIME: `image/webp`
- Compression: Supports both Lossy (VP8 intra-frame prediction) and Lossless modes.
- Alpha Channel: Supported in both lossy and lossless modes.
- Efficiency: Approximately 26% smaller than PNG (lossless) and 25-34% smaller than JPEG (lossy) at equivalent visual quality.
- Best For: High-performance web publishing, e-commerce catalog assets, Core Web Vitals optimization.

### ICO (Windows Icon Resource Container)
- MIME: `image/x-icon`
- Architecture: Binary multi-resolution container file packing multiple bitmap/PNG frames.
- Squeeze Packaging: Automatically packs 16x16, 32x32, 48x48, 64x64, 128x128, and 256x256 pixel frames into a single `.ico` file.
- Alpha Channel: Supported across all frames.
- Best For: Website `favicon.ico`, Windows application icons, desktop shortcuts.

### SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics)
- MIME: `image/svg+xml`
- Architecture: XML-based vector graphic definitions using coordinate math (`<path>`, `<rect>`, `<polygon>`).
- Squeeze Vectorizer: Implements a client-side marching-squares contour tracing algorithm that vectorizes raster silhouettes into scalable vector SVG paths.
- Best For: Logos, monochrome icons, vector assets requiring infinite zoom without pixelation.

---

## 3. Perceptual Quality Engine: Structural Similarity (SSIM)

Rather than arbitrary compression sliders, Squeeze integrates client-side SSIM (Structural Similarity Index Measure) quality measurement:
- Math: Evaluates luminance, contrast, and structural degradation against the uncompressed source bitmap.
- Scale: 0.0 (total distortion) to 1.0 (bit-identical match).
- Target Ratio & Sweet Spot: Squeeze dynamically targets an SSIM score >= 0.95, delivering between 50% and 80% byte reductions while keeping compression artifacts imperceptible to human vision.

---
